message: Maybe you've explained this, and I've simply missed it.  Or maybe it is just so obvious, but I'm left a bit uncertain as to how you see it -- but, how do you see appropriation playing out in the writing classroom?  Maybe this is the part where you say you don't have a sufficient grasp on rhetoric and the economics of distribution, but I'm wondering who you see as appropriating writing (in a classroom) at the various points from production to distribution.
